T: A spoonful of sugar. Then a full plate.
D: A magical nanny arrives at Cherry Tree Lane to look after the Banks children.
P: Serve the snacks when Uncle Albert's tea party floats up to the ceiling.
S: the tea party on the ceiling with Uncle Albert
Finger sandwiches of cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard, crusts off, on a tiered plate.
the bird woman on the steps of St Paul's
Seeded crackers of sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame, baked at 160C for an hour, with soft cheese.
Short pastry half-moons filled with beef, potato, swede and onion, crimped and baked golden. Mix 400g diced chuck steak with 250g diced potato, 150g swede, 1 onion and plenty of pepper.
M: Sunday at the Banks house on Cherry Tree Lane
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes, peas and gravy.
Beef chuck and onion pie simmered 3 hours, under a puff pastry lid baked at 200C, with mash and parsley sauce.
W: Mary and Bert's jolly holiday in the chalk drawing
Raspberries blended with sugar syrup and lemon, frozen and scraped every hour until fluffy, served in glass dishes with wafers.
K: English breakfast tea brewed in a pot, served with milk and sugar cubes.

s.note: the tea party on the ceiling with Uncle Albert
s.how: Spread white bread with cream cheese and layer with thin cucumber. Mash 4 hard-boiled eggs with salt and spread with mustard cress. Fill more with ham and a little mustard. Cut off the crusts, slice into fingers and stack on a tiered plate.
Mix 400g diced chuck steak with 250g diced potato, 150g swede, 1 onion and plenty of pepper. Fill 4 rounds of shortcrust, crimp closed, brush with egg and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

m.note: Sunday at the Banks house on Cherry Tree Lane
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg beef topside at 200C to medium and rest. Whisk 150g flour, 3 eggs and 300ml milk into a batter and bake in hot oiled muffin tins for 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside, cook peas and make gravy with pan juices and stock.

w.note: Mary and Bert's jolly holiday in the chalk drawing
w.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend 500g raspberries with the syrup and the juice of a lemon, then strain out the seeds. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Serve in glass dishes with ice cream wafers.

d.how: Warm the teapot with boiling water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and a litre of freshly boiled water and steep for 4 minutes. Pour into cups with milk and serve with a bowl of sugar cubes and a spoon for each.
